method: Native in-app browser player; select/play controls exercised and sampled DOM/screenshots, alongside actual encoded contact/cue frames. No continuous computer-vision or subjective human listening claim.
limits: The player was sometimes muted or paused during live review; recorded states are retained honestly. Creative sound taste and audience performance are not measured here.
observations: Inspected sketch/pencil contact, chin/closed-eye brainfreeze, shrug/open hands, lightning/star thought change, true profile and small proud thumbs-up. No cat/book-show repetition.
